Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the financing of higher education institutions' maintenance and operations through the use of certificates of participation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of certificates of participation tofinance maintenance and operations of institutions of higher education;and adding a new section to chapter 28B.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Institutions of higher education shall receive state operatingfunds for maintenance and operations on instructional space financedthrough certificates of participation under chapter 39.94 RCW to thesame extent state funding would be provided if the space were financedusing state bonds. This section applies to facilities in which thecertificate of participation is issued after the effective date of thissection.
